lead.headline: Abrego Garcia leaves U.S. for Spain, ending two-year deportation fight
lead.dek: Lawyers say he departed Dulles on a commercial flight rather than on an ICE plane to Liberia
body: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the Salvadoran national whose mistaken deportation to El Salvador last year became a test case for President Donald Trump's immigration crackdown, left the United States for Spain on Tuesday night, his lawyers and Trump administration officials said, ending a legal fight of nearly two years.

Abrego Garcia, 31, boarded a commercial flight from Washington Dulles International Airport to Madrid with his wife and brother present, NBC News reported. A federal judge had ordered him to leave the country by Tuesday, a U.S. official told NBC News. His attorney Simon Sandoval-Moshenberg said he left "a free man" rather than "in shackles" on a government flight to Liberia.

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin called the departure a self-deportation. Abrego Garcia was sent to El Salvador's CECOT prison in March 2025, returned in June 2025 to face smuggling charges a judge later dismissed, and fought removal to Liberia. His lawyer said he may seek to return as the husband and father of U.S. citizens.

briefs.headline: Trump gives Giuliani the Presidential Medal of Freedom
briefs.summary: President Donald Trump presented the medal to former New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani, 82, in the Oval Office on Tuesday, the third of his second term.

briefs.headline: Jury convicts Huawei of trade secrets conspiracy, bank fraud
briefs.summary: A U.S. jury convicted Huawei on Tuesday of conspiring to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud but acquitted it of racketeering conspiracy. Huawei said it will appeal.

briefs.headline: Judge orders Fulton County to hand over 2020 ballot copies
briefs.summary: Judge Kelly Lee Ellerbe ordered the county to give Georgia's State Election Board digital copies of the FBI-seized 2020 ballots by 5 p.m. Wednesday.

briefs.headline: Plane crash off Mississippi coast kills 6, including 2 boys
briefs.summary: Divers found four adults and boys ages 8 and 10 dead in a Cessna 210 that went down Tuesday between Pascagoula and Horn Island, the Coast Guard said.

briefs.headline: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi refinery and Riyadh tower
briefs.summary: Saudi defense officials said four drones were downed at the Ras Tanura refinery and 11 people were hurt when a tower in Riyadh's financial district was hit.

briefs.headline: China investigates Shanghai party chief Chen Jining
briefs.summary: China's anti-corruption watchdog said Tuesday the Politburo member is suspected of violating party discipline. It gave no further details.

briefs.headline: Colombian forces storm Cartagena supermarket, free hostages
briefs.summary: President Abelardo de la Espriella said all captives were freed and one gunman killed early Wednesday, ending a 17-hour siege that followed a failed armored-car robbery.

briefs.headline: UK warns defense suppliers of Russian sabotage threat
briefs.summary: The Defence Ministry and MI5 said Tuesday firms supplying Ukraine's military could be targeted by proxies using arson. Russia's embassy in London denied it.

briefs.headline: McCuskey withdraws subpoenas against environmental groups
briefs.summary: McCuskey ended his probe of West Virginia Rivers Coalition and 350.org over climate claims and said the subpoenas will not be reissued. A federal judge halted the inquiry in October.

briefs.headline: Park Service pauses Thurmond demolitions after town sues
briefs.summary: The Park Service told its contractor to suspend work on 12 structures in Thurmond and Prince for about 30 days, a court filing Tuesday said. Demolition was set to begin Nov. 30.

briefs.headline: Bank seeks $54.3M from The Greenbrier after loan judgment
briefs.summary: First Guaranty Bank asked a judge to amend a Nov. 18 ruling to show $54.3 million owed on a defaulted pandemic loan, with interest at $20,627 a day. The resort said it may appeal.

briefs.headline: Morrisey questions $410M school funding formula overhaul
briefs.summary: A draft state formula adding weights for special education would cost about $410 million; Gov. Patrick Morrisey said the issue is how money is spent. Lawmakers return in January.

regional.item: Council member Tia Rumbaugh resigned her Huntington District 3 seat Tuesday ahead of joining the Cabell County Commission Jan. 1.
The Putnam County Development Authority won a $500,000 SBA award to rehabilitate the former Kanawha Manufacturing building in Red House.
The Urban Renewal Authority sold two lots Tuesday and heard four HOME-funded houses could cost $192,500 to $242,000 each.
A proposed Big Ditch Lake campground is headed for preliminary design, with the commission and EDA yet to settle who leases the state land.

away.item: The Bennington Select Board on Monday accepted the town's $6,900 share of a $76.2M Albertsons opioid settlement, paid over nine years.

hotspots.item: The former Allegheny Wood Products mill in Cowen, reported sold at auction Sept. 17, is back on the block in an online auction closing Dec. 10, the Echo said Tuesday.
The Topsail Christmas Flotilla returns to Surf City's Soundside Park Dec. 5, with a 58-vendor market from 11 a.m. and decorated boats arriving about 6 p.m.

briefs.headline: Titchener gets 30 months for CrossRoads brewery fire
briefs.summary: A B.C. Supreme Court judge sentenced Richard Titchener Tuesday for the 2025 downtown fire that caused about C$1.8M in damage; 275 days remain after credit for time served.

briefs.headline: Regional district drafts asks for seven new B.C. ministers
briefs.summary: Fraser-Fort George will raise Forest Service road closures and industrial camps' strain on local services when the Natural Resources Forum returns to Prince George, chair Lara Beckett said.

briefs.headline: Doerkson issues mandate letters to new B.C. cabinet
briefs.summary: Premier Lorne Doerkson's letters, released Tuesday, require each minister to commit to a measurable result and a delivery date and send new funding requests to Treasury Board.

briefs.headline: Squamish declares emergency as coastal storm meets king tides
briefs.summary: Environment Canada warned of up to 225 mm of rain along the B.C. coast Wednesday; Squamish activated its emergency operations centre, with the highest tides forecast Thursday.

briefs.headline: McGuinty rebuffs Pentagon critique of Canadian defence spending
briefs.summary: The defence minister said Tuesday he cannot explain the Pentagon fact sheet, that NATO and Norad co-operation is unchanged and Canada has a path to 4% of GDP on defence by 2030.

briefs.headline: Macklem says global economic shocks will grow larger, more frequent
briefs.summary: The Bank of Canada governor said Tuesday trade conflict and war will keep disrupting prices; inflation runs near 3% and the bank's final 2026 rate decision comes in December.

briefs.headline: Pakistani astronaut becomes first foreigner aboard Tiangong
briefs.summary: Shenzhou-24 docked 3.5 hours after launch Wednesday and Muhammad Zeeshan Ali entered the station with two Chinese crewmates, the China Manned Space Agency said

briefs.headline: Ariane 6 puts 36 Amazon Leo satellites in orbit from Kourou
briefs.summary: Tuesday's launch brought the broadband fleet to 432 satellites, nine days after a Vulcan failure destroyed 40. Amazon said a Falcon 9 flight moves up to December

briefs.headline: Ambulance antibiotics fail to cut sepsis deaths in Ontario trial
briefs.summary: A 2,048-patient randomized trial in JAMA found 90-day in-hospital mortality of 18.0% with ceftriaxone given by paramedics versus 18.4% with placebo

briefs.headline: Cave teeth keep Homo erectus in Asia 60,000 years longer
briefs.summary: Enamel proteins from nine teeth in Guangxi date the species to 324,000-184,000 years ago, a University of Copenhagen-led team reported in Nature

briefs.headline: Benchmark finds top AI agents fail a third of everyday tasks
briefs.summary: ShellBench, built with UC Berkeley, Hugging Face and Red Hat, found OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta models failed over a third of tasks and 15.7% of runs broke a safety rule

briefs.headline: Tidal to delete 27 million AI-generated tracks under new ban
briefs.summary: The streamer said fully AI-made songs are 6.3% of its catalog and 43% of uploads over 90 days, and that 96% of them drew zero plays. Removals begin Dec. 9

briefs.headline: UK cyber agency reports marked rise in AI-driven attacks
briefs.summary: The NCSC said attackers since September have run red-team frameworks such as ARTEX with cheap open models to exploit weak passwords and exposed systems, causing downtime

weather_ear: The weather desk files Wednesday's forecast at 7:15.
kicker: Summers-New River carries no regional line today; the Hatsu basho opens Jan. 10 in Tokyo, 46 days out.

art.caption: Ariane 6 climbing off its pad at Kourou on Tuesday with 36 Amazon Leo satellites, lightning towers around it and exhaust rolling left.
